verdict.rationale: Linear is a SaaS product with built-in AI features, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that excludes customer data from AI model training. The private teams, Okta access, and app approval items are access controls, not training-data controls, and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
